correctness.rationale: Exact coordinate reduction uses β=4. Symbolic expansion confirms nonnegative dissipation identity; energy gives subcritical rate and critical harmonic square-summability. Logarithmic-mesh lemma turns harmonic summability plus O(1/k) regularity into endpoint convergence. For every supercritical γ>2, a dominated-convergence offset bound and convex-combination invariant prove a positive limiting nullspace coordinate. Geometric u convergence follows from the 2-step norm bound. `verify.py` checks algebra and finite recurrences, not infinite conclusions.

value.rationale: Provides a complete threshold for a natural rank-deficient bilevel benchmark: acceleration allows selection even when \(\sum_k\alpha_k<\infty\) up to the critical exponent, but for every higher exponent an admissible offset leaves permanent nullspace bias.
